ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central vertical axis dominated by a dark-pixel column widening at the base. Large contiguous white-pixel zones occupy the majority of the left and right lobes. High-contrast dark-pixel banding observed along the entire trailing edge and concentrated at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body, characterized by a sharp angular convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations forming a jagged, sawtooth-like boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the visible leading edge (bottom) sweeping upward toward tapered, slightly pointed tips; trailing edge follows a generally flat trajectory with high-frequency micro-variations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular, jagged excision or indentation on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe lobe compared to the smoother curvature of the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of low-intensity yellowish-brown focal clusters (mottling) localized on the lower interior quadrant of the left lobe.
